title: Two Kings, One Croissant
logline: Brock and Matteo discover they're chasing the same French woman, escalate into smoothie-versus-risotto warfare, get rated a five each, and then Spain walks in.

scenes.visual: Brock grinning with a pink smoothie in one hand; Matteo frozen mid-stir at the stove, eyebrows crashing together, wooden spoon raised like a sword.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Brock is about to start a war.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He does not know this yet.

lines.speaker: brock-usa
lines.text: Bro. We're both all-in on the same girl?!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: America. Italy. One French woman.

scenes.visual: Poppy leans in the doorway sipping tea, eyebrows up; Brock waves the smoothie proudly; Matteo clutches his chest with both hands.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Brock made a smoothie. Matteo made eight courses.

lines.speaker: matteo-italy
lines.text: You made her a smoothie. I made her a promise.

lines.speaker: poppy-uk
lines.text: Day one and we've got a treaty violation.

scenes.visual: Brock and Matteo nose to nose over a steaming risotto pan, Brock's cap backwards, Matteo's hands mid-gesture, both furious and both smiling politely.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Watch the risotto. It's revenge now.

lines.speaker: brock-usa
lines.text: Full send on the heart, baby!

lines.speaker: matteo-italy
lines.text: My heart is al dente. Yours is a blender.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Oh, that landed.

scenes.visual: Greta writing on a clipboard with zero expression; Poppy peering over her shoulder, delighted, tea mug forgotten.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Greta is logging it. Officially.

lines.speaker: greta-germany
lines.text: Conflict began 11:04. Escalation, 11:06. Efficient.

lines.speaker: poppy-uk
lines.text: She's got a spreadsheet for a stabbing.

scenes.visual: Élodie on a lounger in tiny sunglasses, unmoved; Brock offering the smoothie and Matteo offering the risotto from opposite sides, both leaning in hopefully.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two kings. One croissant. Zero interest.

lines.speaker: elodie-france
lines.text: The smoothie? Five. The risotto? Five. The drama? ...Seven.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She rated the fight higher than both men.

scenes.visual: Brock alone in the Spill Room chair, grin faltering, shaker bottle hugged to his chest like a teddy bear.

lines.speaker: brock-usa
lines.text: A five's basically a nine with room to grow.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody correct him. It's beautiful.

scenes.visual: Lucas mid-dance in shock, Sienna choking on a drink, Rohan flipping his notebook shut, Élodie reapplying red lipstick without blinking.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The villa reacts. Badly.

lines.speaker: sienna-australia
lines.text: She scored them like a diving competition!

lines.speaker: rohan-india
lines.text: I'm recalculating everything. Everything.

scenes.visual: Alejandro at the top of the torch-lit walkway in a crimson shirt, backlit, smoldering; Brock and Matteo staring up in horror, Élodie slowly lowering her sunglasses.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Torches lit. Gate open. Oh no.

lines.speaker: alejandro-spain
lines.text: I heard someone here rates men out of ten. I am the ten.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Élodie lowered the sunglasses. That's a gasp.

lines.speaker: matteo-italy
lines.text: Spain. Of course. Spain.

scenes.visual: Firepit at night: Brock, Matteo and Alejandro in a tense row, Élodie centre-frame with an unreadable stare into the flames.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So. Smoothie, risotto, or smoulder?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Who should Élodie pick? Comment now.

lines.speaker: elodie-france
lines.text: C'est un non. Probably.
lines.delivery: cool, then a flicker of doubt

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Probably? She said probably. Episode two.

caption: Two kings, one croissant, and Spain kicking the door in on DAY ONE 🇺🇸🇮🇹🇫🇷🇪🇸 Who should Élodie pick? Vote in the comments 👇
musicDirection: Original royalty-free tropical-house bed, 118bpm, plucky marimba under comedy beats; swap to a single sustained flamenco-flavoured guitar note plus low sub-drop for Alejandro's arrival; cut to silence on Élodie's 'Probably'.
continuityNotes: Series premiere: establishes Brock vs Matteo rivalry over Élodie.
Élodie's five-out-of-ten rating becomes a running scoreboard motif.
Alejandro arrives claiming Élodie — real intentions unrevealed, seeded for later.
Brock's confidence wobble planted here pays off in the startup-exposure episode.
Greta's conflict log and Poppy's commentary established as recurring devices.
Rohan-Sienna proximity seeded quietly at the pool.
Lucas and Alejandro not yet in conflict — sunshine-king cold war begins next.
